SELECT input_table.country, input_table."gdp (in trillions USD)", input_table.region, input_table.official_language, input_table.internet_penetration, input_table.currency, country_currency_strength.currency
FROM input_table
INNER JOIN country_currency_strength ON input_table.country = country_currency_strength.country
ORDER BY country_currency_strength.currency DESC
